name: Kemory by SeKondBrain
description:
Every AI you talk to has amnesia, and a wall around it. You re-explain the same context to each one, every session, and none of them share what they learn.

Kemory is a permissioned memory that lives across every AI you use. Tell one thing to one assistant and they all understand, with you holding the keys. Connect it to Claude and your preferences, project facts and decisions are there from the first message, including the ones you explained last week, in a different client, on a different machine.

What you can do with it:
- Recall decisions, preferences and context from earlier conversations, without repeating them
- Keep project knowledge in one place and draw on it across Claude, Claude Code, Cursor and any other MCP client
- Carry a thread from one AI into another without losing where you were
- Inspect everything Kemory holds about you, and delete any of it

How it is governed: every memory is scoped to a user and an organisation, and that scoping is enforced in the database rather than in a prompt. Colleagues cannot read each other's memories by default. Memories are shared only when you deliberately promote them to a shared namespace, and every event lands in a hash-chained, tamper-evident audit log. We do not train on your data.

Kemory reads only what you deliberately capture into your own account. It never reads Claude's own memory, chat history, conversation summaries or your files.

Kemory reads and writes. 17 memory tools, each titled and annotated, so your client knows reading from writing from deleting before it runs anything.

Requires a SeKondBrain account. Sign in over OAuth; there is nothing to install and no keys to paste.

Kemory by SeKondBrain — the memory layer of the SeKondBrain Cognitive OS. Beta Version.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Kemory by SeKondBrain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Kemory by SeKondBrain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.kemory.s9n.ai/mcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Kemory by SeKondBrain MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kemory by SeKondBrain lists 17 MCP tools, including kemory_check_access, kemory_consolidate_session, kemory_delete_memory, kemory_find_similar, kemory_get_compressed, kemory_get_context, kemory_get_history, kemory_get_raw, kemory_get_session_context, kemory_get_user_context, kemory_list_namespaces, and kemory_list_skills.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Kemory by SeKondBrain?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Kemory by SeKondBrain in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Kemory by SeKondBrain MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kemory by SeKondBrain requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Kemory by SeKondBrain is developed by SeKondBrain AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
